topics.name: Clinical imaging and biomedical health
topics.summary: Clinical imaging work spans surgical manipulation, medical landmark localization, MRI translation, anomaly diagnosis, and esports screening, using learned priors and uncertainty checks to support reliable decisions.

topics.name: LLM agent tools and workflows
topics.summary: Tool-augmented language agents use execution traces, documentation, and runtime feedback to select actions and recover from mistakes across coding, operations, and graphical interfaces.

topics.name: LLM reasoning and model adaptation
topics.summary: Language-model adaptation work covers sign-language translation, recoverable long-form generation, test-time augmentation, and controllable cross-modal modeling, evaluating how extra visual or inference-time structure changes reasoning.

topics.name: Robotics, autonomy, and control
topics.summary: Robotic autonomy work spans policy execution, haptic direction cues, aerial perception, nonlinear model-predictive control, and scenario-tree planning, with emphasis on real-time decisions under physical constraints.

topics.name: Image generation and restoration
topics.summary: Image and signal restoration papers study diffusion caching, audio-visual enhancement, alpha-aware generation, normalization in diffusion transformers, and plug-and-play reconstruction to improve quality within tight budgets.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and music
topics.summary: Speech, audio, and music papers study separation, description, speaker extraction, and generative sound, comparing temporal, binaural, and multimodal representations under noise and real-world listening conditions.

topics.name: Visual perception and 3D reconstruction
topics.summary: Perception and reconstruction methods build view-consistent 3D scenes, implicit SLAM maps, dense face geometry, wireless localization fields, and cross-view descriptors from incomplete visual evidence.

topics.name: Graph, federated, and scientific learning
topics.summary: Structured scientific learning connects causal shortcut discovery, physics-informed equations, inverse scattering, and elliptic PDE solvers, using explicit domain structure to make predictions interpretable and stable.

topics.name: Applied data and forecasting
topics.summary: Applied forecasting benchmarks connect streaming commentary, energy demand, air-traffic capacity, crop recognition, and traffic prediction to realistic input limits and geometry-aware or decomposition-based models.

topics.name: Model and agent security evaluation
topics.summary: Security evaluations probe swarm decision policies, safe human following, and attacks on contrastive embedding geometry, highlighting the tension between task performance and adversarial or proximity constraints.

topics.name: Optimization and learning systems
topics.summary: Learning-system studies connect cognitive decision models, scientific anomaly search, invariant-learning objectives, adaptive world-model execution, and active inference through formal or empirically checked optimization principles.

topics.name: Applied systems and governance
topics.summary: Deployment-oriented AI studies address data pipelines, domain adaptation, tabular estimation, warehouse delivery, and self-evolving policies, pairing structured models with checks for reproducibility and operational risk.

topics.name: Healthcare agents and biomedical decision support
topics.summary: Healthcare-agent and biomedical studies align modalities for diagnosis, reason over clinical or sensor data, and evaluate structured representations, showing how domain knowledge can guide multimodal decisions.

topics.name: LLM reasoning and instruction following
topics.summary: Instruction-following evaluations span multilingual interviews, cross-lingual safety pathways, agent harnesses, autonomous driving, and legal time reasoning, revealing how reliability changes across language and domain.

topics.name: LLM compression and quantization
topics.summary: Efficiency studies examine missing-data learning, federated resource allocation, visual-token removal, and LLM post-training, treating compression and adaptation as task-dependent decisions rather than uniform pruning.

topics.name: Factuality, hallucination, and calibration
topics.summary: Reliability studies test visual editing, RGB-D motion, multimodal distortion detection, and subjective bias judgments, broadening factuality beyond text-only answers to perception and generation.

topics.name: Federated optimization and personalization
topics.summary: Transfer and personalization studies audit foundation-model datasets, corpus markup, segmentation labels, and robot demonstrations, asking which metadata and local updates carry across users, languages, and tasks.

topics.name: Graph representation learning
topics.summary: Graph-learning work develops hop extraction, RISC-V traversal, fair spectral forecasting, temporal EEG fusion, and physics-informed molecular reservoirs, pairing scalable structure with domain constraints.

topics.name: Software testing and repair with language models
topics.summary: Repository-level coding-agent benchmarks and program-repair methods focus on issue clarification, visual code context, test generation, and rubric-based evaluation, exposing where automated fixes still need human review.

topics.name: Agent memory, planning, and orchestration
topics.summary: Agent architectures select skills and plans from execution utility, emotion or task context, while runtime assurance and rule-gated analytics constrain actions before they reach production.

topics.name: Learning theory and convergence
topics.summary: Learning-theory papers derive limits for noisy stochastic optimization and study rectification, anomaly search, proof uncertainty, and score-driven online filters, connecting guarantees to nonideal data and dynamics.

topics.name: Uncertainty quantification and causal statistics
topics.summary: Uncertainty work tracks distribution shift in vision-language systems, propagates random-field error, audits clinical overconfidence, detects outliers, and estimates privacy risk for delegated queries.

topics.name: Tool-using agents and workflow recovery
topics.summary: Tool-using systems coordinate specialist roles, inspect execution traces, and recover from failed workflows; structured routing and expert merging are used to make task completion more dependable.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and social reasoning
topics.summary: Multi-agent research studies experience sharing, social-game interaction, trajectory attribution, and self-evolution, using feedback and structured coordination to improve collective reasoning beyond isolated prompts.

topics.name: Optimization, control, and decision methods
topics.summary: Decision and game-theoretic methods address network interdiction, decentralized learning rates, supervisor resilience, equilibrium behavior, and regret, tying optimization guarantees to strategic multi-agent settings.

topics.name: Autonomous navigation and aerial systems
topics.summary: Navigation and aerial-control papers combine world models, active dialogue grounding, multimodal planning, and physically consistent dynamics to handle sparse goals, open environments, and changing motion.

topics.name: Generative image modeling and watermarking
topics.summary: Generative-image studies add frequency-domain marks, restore diffusion detail, and test watermark removal or cryptographic weaknesses, framing provenance as a contest between fidelity, resilience, and attackability.

topics.name: Explainable AI and human-centered evaluation
topics.summary: Interpretability work pairs probes, explanations, and user-facing evaluation with vision or decision systems; findings show that useful explanations expose evidence and uncertainty instead of merely increasing confidence.

topics.name: LLM serving and memory efficiency
topics.summary: Serving research treats memory as an active systems resource: agents compile useful context, streaming summarizers recover missing evidence, and linear or multi-structure memory modules extend long-horizon work.

topics.name: Neural retrieval and RAG systems
topics.summary: Retrieval systems combine vector, graph, and relational stores with source auditing, version-aware legal corpora, and knowledge-graph construction to improve grounding and explanation in complex questions.

topics.name: Graph forecasting and structured networks
topics.summary: Structured prediction studies use graph ranking, categorical palettes, executable language-model strategies, and accounting logs to turn relational context into ordered or actionable decisions.

topics.name: Biomedical imaging and clinical prediction
topics.summary: Biomedical prediction papers use mask-guided attention, scanning-probe measurements, and contact-aware human-scene representations to extract reliable structure from difficult visual or physical observations.

topics.name: Healthcare agents and longitudinal decision support
topics.summary: Healthcare agents turn longitudinal records into interactive triage and treatment planning, with multimodal consultation systems aimed at timely decisions that remain grounded in patient history.

topics.name: Efficient model adaptation and distillation
topics.summary: Efficient adaptation studies measure tokenization cost and script choices for underserved languages, including code-mixed corpora where compact transfer depends on linguistic coverage rather than model size alone.

topics.name: Security, privacy, and robustness
topics.summary: Robustness work targets backdoor selection, low-frequency attacks on language-and-audio systems, and inherited vulnerabilities in merged diffusion models, emphasizing threats that evade standard benchmarks.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and online planning
topics.summary: Online-learning papers study policy updates from noisy labels or user feedback and selective exploration, allocating adaptation where interaction evidence is most informative.

topics.name: Personalized agent memory and context
topics.summary: Personalized incident-response agents combine graph-based service context with long-horizon planning, turning operational history into targeted diagnoses and recovery actions.

topics.name: Medical imaging reconstruction and segmentation
topics.summary: Reconstruction and segmentation work focuses on correcting spatial predictions and validating model outputs, with attention to robustness, interpretability, and deployment-specific failure modes.

topics.name: Speech recognition and enhancement
topics.summary: Speech-focused work connects voice analysis with privacy-preserving anonymization, asking whether interpretable acoustic signals can support screening without exposing identifiable speaker information.

topics.name: Music generation and sound modeling
topics.summary: Audio-generation studies estimate expressive MIDI dynamics and model continuous-time sound or geometry, using differentiable representations to preserve structure across instruments and evolving signals.

topics.name: Search ranking and medical retrieval
topics.summary: Retrieval studies combine dense indexes, reranking, graph context, and evidence checks; domain benchmarks show that query intent, structure, and validity determine grounded usefulness beyond recall alone.

topics.name: Medical sensing and clinical workflow
topics.summary: Clinical workflow studies translate institutional rules into machine-readable graphs and audit whether responsible-NLP checklists measure substantive practice, linking sensing systems to governance and reproducibility.

topics.name: Reasoning reliability and consistency
topics.summary: Reliability work couples combinatorial solvers with constraint synthesis for language instructions, testing whether models and algorithms obey explicit structure instead of exploiting superficial shortcuts.

topics.name: Clinical vision and patient monitoring
topics.summary: Clinical-vision and monitoring themes emphasize quality control after segmentation and schema-aware database querying, showing that reliable downstream decisions depend on validated visual outputs and structured records.
